messages:
jess_fin: FYI vendor Arcadia Analytics submitted INV-48923 for $12,450 but AP auto-flagged it as missing PO. Vendor says invoice covers two SOWs plus freight consolidated on one invoice. Can we route for manual review?

mike_proc: Please attach the PDF and any remittance info. If there are two SOWs we might need to split into two POs or request a non-PO approval.

jess_fin: attached invoice and vendor email. They referenced contract C-2024-Arcadia instead of a PO and asked that shipping be split across PO-789 and PO-790.

sara_fpna: AP auto-match output: `MATCH_FAIL: multiple PO candidates [PO-789, PO-790]; ambiguous allocation; freight unmapped`. Three-way match failed.

rohit_eng: Work corresponds to two change orders under SOW-A and SOW-B. Procurement had a backlog and only one PO was issued. Vendor should have used PO ref but used contract instead.

amanda_ops: Options: ask vendor to reissue with PO refs (clean), or move to Non-PO Review for manual GR/receipt verification and finance approver sign-off. Timelines?

mike_proc: Vendor reissue preferred but may not meet Friday payrun. For speed move to Non-PO Review and open a procurement ticket to issue missing PO. I'll route GL approval to @sara_fpna.

procure-bot: Ticket PR-4521 created: "Arcadia INV-48923 - missing PO / split freight" assigned to procurement-queue.

ap-system: Invoice INV-48923 moved to Non-PO Review. Hold timer 72h. Attach receipts/acceptance to PR-4521.

sara_fpna: Provisional GL split: SOW-A -> GL 5601 (product research), SOW-B -> GL 5602 (infra). Split freight pro-rata by line totals. Approver: sara_fpna.

jess_fin: I'll ask vendor to reissue and include PR-4521 link. If they can't reissue we'll proceed with manual split and payment hold. :thumbsup:

mike_proc: Following up with procurement to issue missing PO; will update PR-4521 when complete.

rohit_eng: Added acceptance email (deliverables accepted 2024-11-02) to the ticket to help expedite.

amanda_ops: Flagged for Friday payrun. If no vendor reissue by EOD Thursday proceed with manual route per Sara's allocation.

jess_fin: Closing loop when PR-4521 has PO or payment record.
